messages:
maria: Hi team — customer ACME reports generation calls returning 403 while embeddings and rerank requests work. Ticket CS-4821. Repro steps pasted below.

maria: POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
Headers: Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXXXX
Body: {"model":"redwood-1","input":"hi"}

maria: Response: 403 {"error":"insufficient_scope","missing":"inference.generate"} — customer says their app used to work.

devon: Got it, can you drop the key id and which provisioning path created it?

maria: Key id: sk_ak_1234 (from ticket). Provisioned via our Okta -> SCIM connector (provisioner-v2).

samir: Quick thought — we recently normalized scope names (generation -> inference.generate). If the provisioner or SCIM trait had an odd format it may have skipped the map.

ashley: Pulling audit: I see sk_ak_1234 was created with scopes=["embeddings:read","rerank:run"] — no inference/generate present.

maria: Customer insists the SSO group should grant full inference and embeddings. Could a parsing issue drop a scope silently?

infra-bot: Provisioner log 2025-11-12T10:02:14Z: user=svc-acme-scim created sk_ak_1234 scopes_raw="embeddings,rerank," parsed_scopes=["embeddings","rerank"]

devon: That trailing comma in scopes_raw would create an empty token. scim-parser v1.3.2 ignores empty tokens and skips the legacy->new scope remap step (edge case we didn't cover).

samir: Action: patch scim-parser to trim and filter empty tokens, and ensure legacy alias mapping runs even if CSV ends with comma. For immediate mitigation, generate a temp key with full entitlement for the customer.

maria: Creating temporary key now and will share securely with ACME.

maria: temp key created sk_temp_test_abc scopes=["inference.generate","embeddings.create","rerank.execute"] — customer tested, generation call now returns 200 and model output :tada:

ashley: Great. Please record the repro steps and include the provisioner log lines in CS-4821. We should also run a backfill for keys created during the window 2025-11-01 -> 2025-11-20.

devon: +1. Also add a revoke timer on temp keys and notify security.

maria: Done — temp key will be revoked after validation. I updated the ticket with logs and customer confirmation.

oncall: Acknowledged. I'll schedule a hotfix for scim-parser and a backfill job. Noting priority: P1 for affected SSO provisioning path.

maria: Thanks all — I'll keep CS-4821 updated with ETA and customer-facing language.
